executive_summary: BMKB-Groen supports SME borrowing for eligible green investments through accredited financiers. The guarantee-backed credit portion may reach 75% of the financing, with a maximum BMKB credit of EUR 1.5 million; this is repayable finance, not a grant. Large companies are excluded. RVO lists an application period ending 2027-07-01, while the 2026 legal amendment describes an annual opening through 2026-12-31; the operative cutoff is unresolved.
status_rationale: RVO's BMKB-Groen, Wat houden de verruiming en aanpassingen in?, supports borrowing for green investments. Its referenced Energielijst 2026, section E, overlaps the flexibility interests in Time-dependent transmission rights contract (Lion Storage), DataFleX and Grids & Benefits. Uitgesloten bedrijfsgroepen excludes large companies, and no other TenneT route is established; the indirect flexibility connection supports C3.3. The consolidated regulation at wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0035474/ was unreadable, while project dates, total-investment bounds and an unambiguous application cutoff remain unverified.
